name: PStream PS5 Standalone
changelog: v1.0.2: Settings converted to a full Tab view (not a popup modal); global theme accents across all cards, focus rings, buttons, and progress meters; Netflix TV dedicated Search screen with on-screen D-pad keyboard, instant suggestions, and live results grid; fixed DualSense R2 trigger tab-cycle conflict; fixed player error dialog navigation (Retry, Provider Settings, Exit); fixed Settings D-pad navigation straight-down jumping.
